HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the Statement of Deviation/Variation in utilisation ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the Statement of Deviation/Variation in utilisation of the funds raised through the Rights Issue of 9,52,931 Partly Paid-up Equity Shares of the Company ('Rights Issue') for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, duly reviewed by the Audit Committee at its meeting held on November 05, 2026, as Annexure A.

We hereby confirm that there is no deviation or variation in the utilisation of the proceeds of the Rights Issue from the objects stated in the Letter of Offer dated August 13, 2026.

The Rights Issue comprises 9,52,931 Partly Paid-up Equity Shares allotted on September 17, 2026, aggregating to ?714.70 Lakhs. On application, the Company has received ?40 per share (?7.50 towards face value and ?32.50 towards securities premium), aggregating to ?381.17 Lakhs.

HEADLINE: The Board of Directors of Alan Scott Enterprises Limited ('Company') at their meeting held today i.e. Thursday, November 05, 2026, have duly approved the Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated ....
MORE:
The Board of Directors of Alan Scott Enterprises Limited ('Company') at their meeting held today i.e. Thursday, November 05, 2026, have duly approved the Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, together with the Limited review report of the auditors in terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 which is enclosed herein as an annexure.

The Board meeting began at 11:30 AM (IST) and concluded at 11:59 AM (IST).

The above-mentioned financial results and disclosure shall be available on the website at https://thealanscott.com/ of the Company under the financials section.
